## Acceptance checklist

- [ ] Tests were added or updated for the changed behavior.
- [ ] The recorded silent-defect gate is green.
- [ ] Clean fixtures have no new flags.
- [ ] Normal tests and CI make no live model calls.
- [ ] New incomplete, partial, or missing-section behavior is not reported READY.
- [ ] No application secret, local environment file, or owner-only `local_docs/` file is included.
